releaseNotes: Continues the independent unified Chrome PWA for phone and computer. Android APK, iOS and Computer deliveries remain separate.
Smart Review keeps Smart Recommended available and adds bulk selection by Specialty and Medical System. Individual topic selection and editable per-topic question counts remain available.

Question narration supports English (US), English (UK) and Arabic, prefers an identifiable male voice when the device provides one, and uses a slightly slower pace for clearer speech. Tap Read aloud to start; tap the same control again to stop.
Exam Goal Planner supports custom exam names and multiple exam dates. Its default question count is read from the live Question Bank total rather than a fixed planner-only value.
Exam Goal Planner data is stored locally and is included in the versioned full student-data backup because it is an app-owned SHBACE data store.

Study Timer presents a countdown using the configured focus duration, with sound and browser notification alerts when supported. An exact alarm cannot be guaranteed after the browser or device fully closes the app.

A non-destructive explanation audit now accompanies the unchanged 1,718-question bank. All records have an explanation field; 11 short or cross-question-reference explanations are flagged for manual review. No question wording, IDs, answer keys or explanations were changed by this audit.
Pediatrics opens separate collections for Dr. Abdulrahman Al-Joaki MCQs and Previous Questions, each organized by medical systems and topics.
Pediatrics collection artwork is reduced to 256px WebP and embedded in the page; circular CSS clipping hides square corners, with initials as load fallbacks.
Long MCQ stems and answer options use safer wrapping without changing the original question text.
Settings are grouped into Appearance & reading, Study notifications, Onboarding & experience, Backup & data, and Progress management.
